Class VCS

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.toolkit.vcs.AbstractVCS
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.vcs.VCS
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class VCS extends AbstractVCS
A toolkit for inspecting version-control status through IntelliJ's generic VCS layer.

Implements the universal AbstractVCS contract for IntelliJ IDEA, providing provider-agnostic VCS status, unified diffs, local history inspection, and working copy revert.
